serviceList.title: Air Freight Options <highlight>Tailored to Your Needs</highlight>
serviceList.intro: Improve your business supply chain efficiency by choosing the best flexibility in speed and certainty of flight time estimates. Whether for economical regular cargo shipping, daily express priority, or emergency services that arrive today, we are ready to ensure every one of your shipments lands on time with professional security guarantees directly from Soekarno-Hatta Airport to all corners of the archipelago.

reguler.name: Regular Cargo
description: General cargo shipping via scheduled flights from the Soekarno-Hatta Airport Cargo Terminal (CGK) to various destination airports across Indonesia.
This economical air cargo service is perfect for shipping online store parcels, spare parts, regional commodities, and even inter-island moving goods, with transparent per-kilogram rate calculation.
Supports both Port to Port and Port to Door service options with a guarantee of safe, orderly, and easily tracked cargo handling.
reguler.imageAlt: Photo of Regular Cargo by Lion Cargo Logistik at Soekarno Hatta Airport
reguler.recommendation: Recommended for: Online Stores, Distributors, Spare Parts, Garments, & Relocation.

express.name: Cargo Express
express.tagline: First Flight Loading Priority from CGK
description: A high-speed air cargo service that gets guaranteed priority loading slots on the earliest flight schedule from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport.
Highly recommended for shipping valuable goods, urgent industrial samples, and fresh food products (perishable goods) that require minimal handling time during transit.
Cargo clearance is processed quickly at the shipping terminal so your package arrives at the destination city within an efficient and safe time estimate.
express.imageAlt: Photo of Cargo Express priority aircraft at Soetta Airport
express.waMessage: Hello Lion Cargo Logistik, I would like to ask about fast shipping via Cargo Express.
express.recommendation: Recommended for: Seafood, Fresh Food, Factory Samples, & Expensive Goods.

sameday.name: Same Day Service
sameday.tagline: Send in the Morning, Arrive at Your Destination City Today
description: An express service for important documents and super urgent parcels flown directly from Jakarta to the destination city on the same day.
Packages are delivered in the morning to the cargo agent at Soekarno-Hatta Airport and processed straight away on the earliest daily commercial flight.
The best solution for those who need extreme inter-island delivery speed without transit delays.
sameday.imageAlt: Photo of Same Day Service express air cargo
sameday.waMessage: Hello Lion Cargo Logistik, I need the Same Day Service express service today.
sameday.recommendation: Recommended for: Tender Documents, Urgent Medical/Medicine, & Passports/Vital Letters.
